Released in 1973 on the light blue Vibration label, a division of All Platinum Record Co., this 45 is a great addition to collections of Sylvia, early 1970s soul, R&B, and funk records, as well as All Platinum and Sugar Hill history.
Side A: "Pillow Talk" (3:41), written by Sylvia Robinson and Michael Burton, produced by Sylvia Robinson and Michael Burton
Side B: "My Thing" (2:45), written by S. Robinson, produced by Sylvia
Artist: Sylvia
Label: Vibration Records, Inc., a division of All Platinum Record Co.
Format: 7-inch, 45 RPM single
Catalog number: VI-521 (VI-521A on Side A, VI-521B on Side B)
The record shows visible reflections from the glossy vinyl, and the labels appear clean with minimal age-related wear. Offered as pictured.

description:
An elegant Noritake Ivory China serving platter in the Parkridge pattern. A graceful border of sage-green scrolls and leaves winds around the wide rim, dotted with clusters of tiny white flowers with yellow centers. It is framed by a platinum band on the outer edge and a thin platinum line around the well. The soft ivory body and classic design make it a beautiful centerpiece for holiday turkey, roasts, or buffet service, and a great addition to a Parkridge set.
Details:
Style: Large oval serving platter with wide rim and recessed center well
Color: Ivory with sage green, gray, and white floral scroll border; platinum trim
Size: About 16 in long and about 12 in wide (see tape measure photos)
Marks: Backstamp reads “Noritake Ivory China, Japan, 7561, Parkridge” with N wreath logo
Condition:
The floral border is bright and complete, with no visible fading, and the platinum trim on the outer rim and around the well is intact. The photos show no visible chips or cracks. The center well shows light gray utensil marks and faint curved scratches, most visible when the light hits them. There is a small dark spot near the lower left of the well and a few tiny specks near the top edge of the well. The unglazed foot ring on the underside has light gray marks and grime from use, and there is light wear along the raised hanging ridge. Please review all photos. Sold as shown.
